name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
summary: A trail of links that shows where the current page sits.
description: Where the current page sits: a trail of links from the top level to the page, separated by small carets that point the reading direction. Links are muted text that darkens on hover; the page itself is ink and not a link. Names wrap, never cut. A long trail can fold its middle into a ghost ⋯ button that opens a Menu of the hidden pages.

anatomy.description: A navigation landmark with an aria-label ("Breadcrumb").
The ordered trail: a wrapping flex row (gap 6px across, 4px between lines), 13px text on a 20px line, ink-2.
One step of the trail: its link, its page or the ellipsis.

A page above the current one: ink-2, ink on hover (fine pointer) and while pressed; colour over duration.fast. Wraps anywhere, never cut; keeps its own direction. A hit area 6px taller on each side (40px on coarse pointers) without changing its look. An item without an href is the same text, not a link.
The current page (the last item): ink, aria-current="page", not a link.
role=presentation and aria-hidden: a 12px caret-right in ink-3 between two items, mirrored right-to-left.

The real Button (ghost, xs, square, muted, dots-three) as the trigger of a Menu that lists the folded pages; named by its Tooltip; marked data-breadcrumb="ellipsis". It sits on the 20px text line (negative block margins).

items.description: The trail from the top level to the current page: { label, href? }. The last one is the current page.

maxItems.description: Show at most this many items (2 or more): the first, the ⋯ menu, then the last maxItems − 1. Omitted: every item.

events.navigate: (href: string | undefined, item) when a link or a folded page is chosen. React onNavigate, Vue @navigate, Svelte onnavigate; given, it replaces the browser's own navigation (client routers); a click with a modifier key keeps the browser's.

keyboard: Tab reaches each link, then the ⋯ button; the current page is not a stop
Enter follows a link; Enter, Space or ArrowDown on ⋯ open its menu (the Menu's keys)
notes: The landmark is named "Breadcrumb" (label); the current page carries aria-current="page".
Separators are hidden from assistive technology; the list's order says the hierarchy.
The ⋯ button is named by its tooltip (ellipsisLabel); the menu lists the folded pages in order.

motion: links: colour over duration.fast (hover gated to a fine pointer); the press darkens to ink
the ⋯ button and its menu: the Button's and the Menu's own
nothing else moves; nothing plays on first paint
